# `silk/time/plain_month_day`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Days of the year without a year: the [`PlainMonthDay`](#PlainMonthDay) type, such as November 19.

## When to use

Use [`PlainMonthDay`](#PlainMonthDay) for a day that comes back every year: a birthday, an anniversary, a
fixed holiday. [`PlainMonthDay.atYear`](#PlainMonthDay.impl.atYear) gives the date in one year.

## Details

The month and the day are in the ISO 8601 calendar. February 29 is a valid value. The text
form is `MM-DD`.

## Examples

### Find a birthday in two years

```silk
import silk.core.option { Option }
import silk.time.period { Overflow }
import silk.time.plain_date { PlainDate }
import silk.time.plain_month_day { PlainMonthDay }

pub fn main() -> i32 {
  let birthday = PlainMonthDay.make(2, 29)
  match birthday.atYear(2028, Overflow.Reject) {
    Option<PlainDate>.Some { value } => {
      if value.day() != 29 {
        return 1
      }
    }
    Option<PlainDate>.None => {
      return 2
    }
  }
  // 2027 has no February 29.
  match birthday.atYear(2027, Overflow.Constrain) {
    Option<PlainDate>.Some { value } => {
      if value.day() != 28 {
        return 3
      }
    }
    Option<PlainDate>.None => {
      return 4
    }
  }
  return 0
}
```

Import as `PlainMonthDay` with `import silk.time.plain_month_day { PlainMonthDay }`.

## `PlainMonthDay`

```silk
pub struct PlainMonthDay
```

A month and a day of the month, without a year, in the ISO 8601 calendar.

### Details

`==` and `!=` compare the month and the day. There is no order, because a day of the year
is neither before nor after another without a year. `Display` writes `MM-DD`.


Returns day `day` of month `month`, from 1 to 12.

#### Gotchas

A day that no year has, such as February 30, traps. [`PlainMonthDay.checkedMake`](#PlainMonthDay.impl.checkedMake) returns
`None` instead.

<a id="PlainMonthDay.impl.atYear"></a>

### Method `atYear`

```silk
pub fn atYear(self: Self, year: i32, overflow: Overflow) -> Option<PlainDate>
```

Returns the date of this day in the year `year`, or `None` when the date is outside the
range of `PlainDate`, or when the year has no such day and `overflow` is `Reject`.

#### Details

Only February 29 can be absent from a year. `Overflow.Constrain` then gives February 28.

<a id="PlainMonthDay.impl.parse"></a>

### Associated function `parse`

```silk
pub fn parse(text: string) -> Result<PlainMonthDay, TimeParseError>
```

Reads a month and a day from ISO 8601 text such as `11-19`.

#### Details

The text is `MM-DD` or `MMDD`, optionally after `--`, as in `--11-19`. Bracketed
annotations can follow. The text can also be a whole date, with or without a time, in the
form that `PlainDate.parse` reads; the year is checked and then ignored.

#### Errors

- `TimeParseReason.UnexpectedEnd` or `UnexpectedCharacter` if the text does not have that
  form.
- `TimeParseReason.OutOfRange` if no year has that month and day.
- `TimeParseReason.UtcNotAllowed` if the text has the UTC designator `Z`.
- `TimeParseReason.UnsupportedCalendar` if a calendar annotation is not `[u-ca=iso8601]`.
- `TimeParseReason.UnknownCriticalAnnotation` if an annotation with an unknown key starts
  with `!`.
